answer: Because the custody account is separate, an adversary cannot recycle one pool of capital across 124 aliases, and each one needs its own funded meadow account. Deposits are visible in inlet, and sparrow reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 32% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. That bill is paid per identity, so 113 aliases cost 280 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
